Load the handler function pointer v8 from *(a1+28)+8 (the handler-table slot at field 0x1C plus offset 8) and, when non-null, invoke it with the original eight arguments and return its result.
When the handler pointer is null or the C++ exception checks fail, fall through to sub_5934E1 with the exception record first and the remaining arguments reordered.
